| Signal | Metric | Mean±Std | CV% |

### EM 和 voting_conf 3-seed 汇总（conditional split）

| Signal | Metric | Mean±Std | CV% |
|--------|--------|----------|-----|
| **EM** | rho | 0.4082±0.0061 | 1.5% |
| **EM** | AUROC | 0.7881±0.0086 | 1.1% |
| **EM** | ECE | 0.3065±0.0028 | 0.9% |
